origin.origins_backgrounds_two.greenwitc: He pūkenga tūturu a Greenwitches ki te hanga i ngā mea kia puawai.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.hunter.de: Kua whakangungua nga kaiwhaiwhai ki te toi o te kopere.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.swashbuck: Kua ako rātau i te maha o ngā mahi a Derring.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.trader.de: E mōhio ana ngā kaihokohoko ki te whakawhiti taonga.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.deep_mine: Ko te hohonu ake, ko te kaha ake o ngā rongoā hei keri.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.miner.des: Na te mahi i raro i te Kaiwhakaako Miner i ako ai ratou ki te keri tere, ki te kore ka mahue ki te puehu toka.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.blacksmit: He mea nui ake te whiwhi i te kākahu tino pai i te mea e mōhio ana ētahi.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.disenchan: E arotahi ana te Rōpū Disenchanters ki te whakakore i ngā āheinga kāore e hiahiatia ana.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.name: Ko te Akoranga a te Kaihanga
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.desc: Tērā pea ehara rātou i te Kaihoko Matua, engari kāore rātou e whakamate i a koe.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.sentry.de: Tērā pea he puhoi ake, engari ka roa ake pea te haere.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.bounty_hu: Mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki tētahi taunakitanga o te mate, ka whakaratohia e rātau..
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.pickpocke: Tērā pea me tiaki koe i ō taonga utu nui i a rātou i te taha.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.acrobat.d: Kāore he tikanga o ngā taiepa ki tētahi Acrobat
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.butcher.d: E mōhio ana rātau ki te tapahi me te kore e ngaro i te kikokiko.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.alchemist: Ka horahia te mana i te wa e inu ana i ngā rongoā.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.street_ra: I te tipu ake i runga i ngā rori, i ako rātau ki te whakarewa i ō rātau kopu.
Ko te whakato i te kōhao, kua riro hei tikanga tuarua mō ngā Kaitiaki Rakau.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.angler.de: Ahakoa i te kaipuke, i te takutai rānei, ka mau tonu te hī ika i te hī ika pai rawa.
